message:
setup: a tip (not a change) for images on a 12 GB card: --vram-reserve-mib 1000 if a request stalls

With the image encoder on the GPU, the 700 MiB reserve can leave ~200 MiB free on a 12 GB card (UD-IQ4_XS
end-to-end check on an RTX 5070). Setup prints a one-line recommendation; the written config is unchanged.
